subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Vertex or Gemini CLI proof for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83991 before merging the sanitizer slice, or accept source-level proof with an explicit override?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the reported failure is credentialed external-provider behavior and the active PR states that exact-route live proof is still unavailable.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed provider route succeeds.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A Google provider owner can merge the narrow sanitizer change based on source-level proof while this issue remains open for auth-stack follow-up.

options.title: Consolidate broader repair
options.body: Pause the sanitizer PR only if maintainers want one combined Google Vertex auth/setup/gaxios landing path instead.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the sanitizer PR open until exact-head Vertex or Gemini CLI output shows the fixed provider route succeeds.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest inspected connection to the shared Google thinking helper boundary and prior Google provider cleanup decisions.
